purpose: Freeze a deterministic, no-guess Hero portrait source-admission and lossless materialization contract before any 267-Hero bulk install.

stage0Contract.role: 267-Hero identity and public target path contract

sourceAdmissionPrecedence.admission: An immutable explicit Hero ID -> Drive file ID mapping must exist and the fetched bytes must pass all byte/format/provenance checks.

sourceAdmissionPrecedence.reason: sourceArtworkPath coverage is 267/267 but a prefab locator is not bitmap dependency proof.
sourceAdmissionPrecedence.enableCondition: A separate representative dependency-resolution proof must establish an explicit prefab -> texture/sprite -> exported PNG chain and the same admission QA before this source kind can be used.

sourceAdmissionChecks: heroId belongs to the frozen canonical 267-Hero population
exactly one enabled explicit source mapping is selected for the Hero
source bytes are directly readable by the immutable source identifier
MIME type and PNG signature identify a PNG
decoded width and height are positive
RGBA/alpha is present and real transparency is preserved
SHA-256 and byteLength are calculated and frozen at admission
source provenance identifies the base/default character appearance rather than a Skin/SP/alternate appearance
no rarity, SP, faction, frame, background-card, or other UI decoration is baked into the source
unusual filename tokens are never used alone to accept or reject a source
cross-Hero exact-byte duplicates become REVIEW unless an explicit shared-source exception is approved

filenamePolicy.rule: Filename tokens may support investigation but never establish canonical ownership or base/special status by themselves.

forbidden: Unity prefab path to web path transformation
treating a prefab locator as exported bitmap proof
selecting Skin/SP/alternate appearance because it has a similar Hero filename
treating Animation_FIN or any filename token as awakening-skill evidence by itself
starting a 267-Hero copy with unresolved/review mappings
mutating FINAL_FROZEN Hero semantics during asset work
completionCondition: The source precedence, admission states, byte/format/provenance checks, immutable Hero-ID target naming, lossless materialization behavior, conflict behavior, and population-wide bulk gate are deterministic and frozen without claiming unproven 267-source coverage.
